integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone executable verifier are provided; no independent external audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Binary contiguous-factor Parikh sets only; uniqueness is modulo reversal and restricted to words with at most five runs, with explicit collisions at six. Finite computations support but do not prove quantified statements; an equivalent unindexed presentation remains possible.
title: Five-run rigidity and the first collisions of binary factor-composition spectra
